stem.text: What is the definition of standard enthalpy change of neutralisation, $\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{neut}}$?

A.text: $\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{r}}$ when one mole of an aqueous acid is neutralised by an aqueous alkali

B.text: $\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{r}}$ when one mole of an aqueous alkali is neutralised by an aqueous acid

C.text: $\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{r}}$ when one mole of an aqueous acid is neutralised by one mole of an aqueous alkali

D.text: $\Delta H^{\ominus}_{\text{r}}$ when an aqueous acid and an aqueous alkali react together to produce one mole of water
